cases.name: watch-talk
cases.brief: Edit this into a TikTok that would do well: a hook in the first second, tight cuts, captions, motion graphics and sound design at the level of a top studio. Make a cover.
followUps: The graphics feel busy. Keep the best two and make the rest calmer.

cases.name: raw-ramble
cases.brief: This is raw footage with retakes and rambling. Find the strongest 45-60 seconds, cut the retakes and dead air, and finish it to a TechCrunch-level standard: captions, graphics, music, sound. Make a cover.
